game.name: Farming Simulator (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pl)
game.desc: Farming Simulator 2013 is a farm management game for Xbox 360. As the head of a vast estate, the player must tend to his livestock and cultivate his fields with the help of a hundred vehicles of major brands. This 2013 edition includes new animals, more varied crops and a cooperative mode accepting up to 10 players online.
